cases.sentence: Египтяне гнались за вашими отцами со своими колесницами и всадниками до самого ___.
cases.explain: «Красного моря» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

cases.sentence: Я послал перед вами шершней , которые прогнали от вас двух ___.
cases.explain: «аморрейских царей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

cases.sentence: Если вы оставите Господа, делавшего вам добро, и станете служить ___, Он обратится против вас, наведет на вас беду и истребит вас.
cases.explain: «чужим богам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

cases.sentence: — Тогда, — сказал Иисус, — отриньте ___, которые у вас есть, и обратите свои сердца к Господу, Богу Израиля.
cases.explain: «чужих богов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”

cases.sentence: Затем он взял ___ и поставил его там под дубом, возле святилища Господа.
cases.explain: «большой камень» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.
